resources.string: The hub runs on the ship network. Ask the officer who set it up, or scan the QR code shown on the hub\u2019s sign-in page (Pair the Android app) or Admin → Status.
Point the camera at the station poster (or the QR code on the Flow Voice sign-in page)
That QR code is not a Flow Voice hub address: %1$s
The code is printed under the QR code on the station poster (Admin → Stations). The hub address must be set first.
Enter the six digits of the station code.
The “Nearby devices” permission is needed to use a Bluetooth button.
Push-to-talk: hold the on-screen button, volume-up, or a headset button.
Microphone permission is required to answer by voice. You can still answer on screen.
Speech recognition failed: %1$s (%2$s). Install the language in the phone\u2019s speech settings or choose another voice language.
